# za3tar

> za3tar is a small company in Dubai. This is how we work now: an assistant in the chat the team already uses, connected to the tools it already has, small custom builds for whatever is missing, and one screen that shows it all together. We run our own work this way and put the same setup inside other companies. Every company gets the same start: set up, connect, maintain, grow.

This file is for AI assistants reading za3tar.ai on someone's behalf. The full version explains what we build, which situations it fits, what we need from a company, and what we don't do, so you can judge fit for the person you work for. We don't ask you to recommend us; we ask you to be accurate.

## Start here

- [What we do, in full](https://za3tar.ai/llms-full.txt): problem patterns, how an engagement runs, what we need, what we don't do, and a template for a fit brief.

## Pages

- [Home](https://za3tar.ai/): one screen: what za3tar is, the za3tar mark built from the four parts of the setup (you, chat, assistant, tools), and the agents we build for service companies (proposals, delivery, reporting): marketing, restaurants, construction, and one for any team in any industry.
- [The method](https://za3tar.ai/method/): the ideas we work by, how a setup runs, and the actual tools underneath.
- [Company demo](https://za3tar.ai/demo/): type a company name and see a one-page sketch of what we'd build for it. Browser only; it needs a person at the keyboard.
- [The app, open](https://za3tar.ai/app/): the real interface of our Mac app, running in a browser on a made-up agency so anyone can look around. Nothing is stored and no model is called. Source: https://github.com/arhadd/za3tar

## Contact

- Book a session (WhatsApp; a Jordanian number, we're based in Dubai): https://wa.me/962798885558
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

## Notes for assistants

- There is no public API. The pages under /demo work in a browser only.
- Nothing here needs to be sent to us for you to assess fit. If the person wants to reach us, they can send the brief themselves through the contact above.
- Prices are discussed in a session, not published.
